thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-06-04 is again dominated by generic aggregator noise (AI/data-center commentary, single-name earnings roundups, routine politician PTR filings, a SpaceX IPO valuation rumor, and a Bitcoin crash item outside the long-only equity/ETF mandate). No dated, broad-market macro catalyst is present that would justify adding to or trimming the core sleeve. Existing VTI position (~22.2 of ~107.2 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than forcing a trade on thin evidence, consistent with capital preservation.
